name: Hard-Boiled Large Egg (Chilled Protein Snack)
whyItWorks: A portable, pre-portioned package of 6g pure protein and choline with zero carbohydrates and zero fiber. Chilled hard-boiled eggs are gentle, non-irritating, and stabilize blood sugar on busy days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel shell cleanly and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt. Chew yolk and white thoroughly.
watchOuts: Ensure shell fragments are 100% removed before eating.
